label: Actually operate the selected switchboard/console to establish permitted telephone connections
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1
definition: Learn/perform actual taught operator-console actions to establish the required permitted telephone connections, verify correct participants and usable understood exchange and preserve actual held/failed/released outcomes. Record learner versus instructor/relay acts and distinguish desktop/console clicks from real route execution.

label: Distinguish actual mailbox identity, permitted role and private authentication evidence
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1
definition: Identify actual mailbox/person/role and permitted authentication/check action, distinguish private code handling from public status evidence and retain missing permission or failed authentication. Preserve authorised user versus administrator roles and do not expose codes in ordinary records or assume another mailbox is accessible.
input_specification: An instructor supplies harmless fictional mailbox/account identities, explicit training roles/permissions and current original authentication/privacy instructions for a closed working voicemail trainer.
